Hi Lena —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the next session: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost by ~30% for your batch-reporting pipelines while meeting 99th percentile latency targets for ad-hoc analytics.
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms p95 on the 2k token workload, predictable throughput for daily jobs, and clear data isolation controls for PCI scope.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Marcus (ML infra), Anika (security/compliance), and a product sponsor (tbd).

Recommended next step: 30-minute product preview focused on architecture and ops — target audience: ML infra + security + one product sponsor. During that session we’ll:
  * show a short run-through of a model serving flow (10 min)
  * review routing/caching profiles that impact cost (10 min)
  * agree on a mutual action plan and next owners (10 min)

Can you confirm which two or three people you want on the call? Below are three windows that work for our SMEs (all PT):
  1) Tue Aug 10 — 09:00–09:30 PT
  2) Thu Aug 12 — 14:00–14:30 PT
  3) Thu Aug 13 — 10:00–10:30 PT

If none of those fit, tell me two preferred slots and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan to speed the contracting/PO discussion if this is useful.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa and Neha to help capture security and success criteria notes.
